Official discussion through Sofia Alvarez's 10:58 wrap.
[2026-04-29T10:30:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Morning everyone — thanks for being on time. I want to keep us tight today, we've got four things to get through and I'd like to wrap by 11. Daniel, Mei, you good to dive in?
[2026-04-29T10:30:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Morning. Yep, ready.
[2026-04-29T10:31:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Hey Sofia, hey Daniel. Ready.
[2026-04-29T10:31:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Great. Agenda: flight carriers, room allocation, the deposit budget, and our payment and document deadlines. Let's start with carriers. Mei, you took the deeper look at the three airlines — which ones are we putting a group hold on?
[2026-04-29T10:32:00Z] Mei Tanaka: So I went through TAP Air Portugal, Iberia Airlines, and Vueling. Quick read: TAP has the best group fare into Lisbon — about $1,450 per traveler round trip with a checked bag, and their group fare counts as a scheduled carrier under our Allianz Travel group policy for trip-interruption cover. Iberia Airlines is at about $1,320 per traveler, the group-seating guarantee is weaker, but their on-time numbers into Seville are slightly better in the reviews I pulled. Vueling is the cheapest at roughly $980, but that's before bags and seat selection, and they won't hold a group block this far out, which I don't think works for sixteen of us.
[2026-04-29T10:34:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yeah, I'd drop Vueling. The no-frills model is fine for a couple, but with four families and kids, people are going to expect bags and seats together without fighting for them.
[2026-04-29T10:34:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Agreed. So we move TAP and Iberia to a formal group-fare request and drop Vueling?
[2026-04-29T10:35:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Yes, that's my recommendation.
[2026-04-29T10:35:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Plus one.
[2026-04-29T10:35:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Good. Decision: TAP and Iberia go to a group-fare request, Vueling is out. Mei, can you draft the flight hold request this week and share it for review by Friday?
[2026-04-29T10:36:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Will do. I'll have it in the shared folder by end of day Friday.
[2026-04-29T10:36:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Perfect. Item two — room allocation. I want to land on a number today. Daniel, what's your read?
[2026-04-29T10:37:00Z] Daniel Okafor: I've been going back and forth. Anything under seven rooms per city and we're cramming families into triples; anything over nine and we're paying for rooms nobody sleeps in. I'd land at eight. Enough for every family to have their own space, small enough that if a hotel falls through we can rebook without it being a scramble.
[2026-04-29T10:38:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I'd second eight. And on which blocks — I'd suggest we use the Porto room block and the Seville room block we already have quotes on. Two reasons: those are the two cities where hotels sell out first in July, so locking them early matters most there, and they're both sized such that eight rooms fits cleanly without splitting us across two hotels.
[2026-04-29T10:39:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: That works for me. Any concern about Lisbon if we only lock those two blocks now?
[2026-04-29T10:39:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Some, but Lisbon has more inventory. I think the trade-off is worth it. We can finalize Lisbon once flights are held.
[2026-04-29T10:40:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Okay. Decision: eight rooms each in the Porto room block and the Seville room block, with a 4-week window for families to confirm their room preferences. Daniel, you'll own the room allocation?
[2026-04-29T10:40:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yep.
[2026-04-29T10:41:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Good. Item three — the deposit budget. Rob confirmed the $48k pot is fully collected. Mei, how do we want to slice it?
[2026-04-29T10:41:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I'd carve out $31k for flights, $13k for lodging — the Porto and Seville blocks plus the Lisbon deposit — and hold the remaining $4k for transfers, which at sixteen travelers covers the Lisbon airport pickup, the Porto-to-Seville coach, and the Seville airport run with a little margin.
[2026-04-29T10:43:00Z] Daniel Okafor: That math works. I'd just flag that the $4k transfers number assumes we don't end up needing a second van for luggage — if we do, that goes up.
[2026-04-29T10:43:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Noted. We can revisit if the coach operator can't fit everything. Decision: the deposit pot is $48k, with $31k flights, $13k lodging, $4k transfers. Daniel, please reflect that in the trip cost sheet today.
[2026-04-29T10:44:00Z] Daniel Okafor: On it.
[2026-04-29T10:44:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Last item — deadlines. I want to be thoughtful here, because if we set them too early families scramble to pay before they're ready, and if we set them too late the fares and rooms slip away from us. Where do we land?
[2026-04-29T10:45:00Z] Mei Tanaka: My proposal is Jun 8 for final payment from every family — full balance, room choices locked — and then Jun 22 for the document and passport check. That gives everyone two weeks after paying to get passports, insurance, and entry paperwork squared away.
[2026-04-29T10:46:00Z] Daniel Okafor: I like that. The two-week gap between payment and documents worked well for us on the last two group trips.
[2026-04-29T10:46:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Agreed. Decision: Jun 8 final payment, Jun 22 document and passport check. Mei, you'll own the document checklist?
[2026-04-29T10:47:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Yes.
[2026-04-29T10:47:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: And Daniel, you'll own the transfers booking — the Lisbon airport pickup and the Porto-to-Seville coach — in coordination with Rob on paying the operator out of the pot?
[2026-04-29T10:48:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yep, I'll loop Rob in this week.
[2026-04-29T10:48:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Perfect. Quick sanity check on action items — Mei: flight hold request by Friday, document checklist owner. Daniel: room allocation, trip cost sheet update today, transfers booking with Rob. Me: I'll update Rob and Leila on the carrier decision and the dates. Anything I'm missing?
[2026-04-29T10:50:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I think that covers it.
[2026-04-29T10:50:00Z] Daniel Okafor: One thing — do we want to set a regular check-in between now and Jun 8? I'd suggest weekly for the next few weeks given how much we have to lock down.
[2026-04-29T10:51:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Good call. Same time next Wednesday, and I'll keep this slot held through Jun 3.
[2026-04-29T10:51:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Works.
[2026-04-29T10:51:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Works.
[2026-04-29T10:52:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: One more thing while I have you both — on the itinerary itself, are we still aligned that the group booking is the core Lisbon, Porto, Seville route, and any side trips are optional add-ons each family books on their own? I don't want the group booking to sprawl before we've locked the core.
[2026-04-29T10:53:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Aligned. Core route only for the group booking. Side trips are on each family.
[2026-04-29T10:53:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Same.
[2026-04-29T10:54:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Great. And on the document checklist — passport validity, entry authorization, and proof of cover under the Allianz Travel group policy. Anything else you want on there?
[2026-04-29T10:55:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I'd add a quick contact form due with the checklist — just three things, an emergency contact, a mobile number that works abroad, and any seating or room requests.
[2026-04-29T10:55:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Plus one on that. Easy to collect, useful.
[2026-04-29T10:56:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Added. So the checklist: passport validity, entry authorization, insurance cover, and the contact form. Mei, please add those to the trip brief.
[2026-04-29T10:56:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Will do.
[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Okay — anything else for either of you before I let you go?
[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Nothing from me.
[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Nothing here.
[2026-04-29T10:58:00Z] Sofia Alvarez: Okay, I think that's everything on my list — let's wrap here. Thanks everyone for staying focused.
[2026-04-29T10:58:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Thanks Sofia — good session.
[2026-04-29T10:58:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Yeah, productive. Talk soon!

[2026-04-29T11:03:00Z] Daniel Okafor: God, I'm stressed. Honestly all this document-deadline talk is hitting close to home — my passport renewal is stuck. I applied in February, it still says 'in process', and my current one expires in September, so it won't meet the three-months-past-departure rule.
[2026-04-29T11:04:00Z] Daniel Okafor: It's funny, I keep thinking I should have figured this out by now — I've been traveling internationally for almost twelve years and I still left the renewal too late.
[2026-04-29T11:04:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Oof. That sounds rough. Where does it stand now?
[2026-04-29T11:05:00Z] Daniel Okafor: I filed an expedite request last week. And because the new passport number isn't issued yet, my ETIAS application is just sitting there — I can't submit it on the old number. I keep telling myself it'll come through.
[2026-04-29T11:05:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Oh, I've got my own mess, honestly. I'm thinking of splitting off to Madrid after Seville for a few days to see my sister, and I have no idea yet how that works with the group return flight.
[2026-04-29T11:06:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yeah. And I haven't raised this with everyone yet, but my mom is going to need wheelchair assistance at the Lisbon and Seville airports and a step-free room — the Porto hotel has stairs up to the annex. And if the passport doesn't come in time, I'm thinking of flying home separately after Porto instead of doing Seville.
[2026-04-29T11:06:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I've been thinking about Madrid the same way. I'd rather book my own leg out of Seville than try to change the group ticket. Half the families probably have something like this going on.
[2026-04-29T11:06:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yeah. We should actually use the flexibility we built into this, huh.
[2026-04-29T11:07:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Ha — right? And honestly the change fee for dropping the Seville leg on your group ticket is going to sting — I'd ask Rob to front it from the $48k pot if I were you, and pay it back after. Your family shouldn't eat that on top of the rebooking.
[2026-04-29T11:07:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Maybe. Anyway — want to talk it through properly later this week? I should have heard back on the expedite by then.
[2026-04-29T11:07:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Yes please. Thursday afternoon?
[2026-04-29T11:08:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Thursday works. I'll text you.
[2026-04-29T11:08:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Anyway, I should head out — see you on the next call.
[2026-04-29T11:08:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yeah, take care.

[2026-04-29T10:48:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yep, I'll loop Rob in this week.

[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Nothing here.

[2026-04-29T11:08:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Yeah, take care.

I don't want the group booking to sprawl before we've locked the core.

[2026-04-29T10:53:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Same.

[2026-04-29T10:55:00Z] Mei Tanaka: I'd add a quick contact form due with the checklist — just three things, an emergency contact, a mobile number that works abroad, and any seating or room requests.
[2026-04-29T10:55:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Plus one on that. Easy to collect, useful.

[2026-04-29T10:56:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Will do.

[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Nothing from me.
[2026-04-29T10:57:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Nothing here.

[2026-04-29T10:58:00Z] Daniel Okafor: Thanks Sofia — good session.
[2026-04-29T10:58:00Z] Mei Tanaka: Yeah, productive. Talk soon!
